user.title: Connect to Homey
user.description:
**What you need to do:**
Enter your Homey IPv4 address (e.g. 192.168.1.x) and create an API key in the Homey app.

**Required permissions:**
Create a new API key in Homey app → Settings → API Keys. Grant at least: Devices (read), Flows (read), System (read). For real-time updates, also enable System → View System (`homey.system.readonly`).

**Limitations:**
Requires Homey Pro 2023 or later. Homey Pro 2019 and older do not support API Keys and cannot be used with this integration.

device_selection.title: Select Devices
device_selection.description: Select which devices to import into Home Assistant. All devices are selected by default—deselect any you don't want to import.

device_management.title: Manage Devices
device_management.description:
Select which devices to include in Home Assistant. Currently selected devices are pre-checked. You can add or remove devices as needed. Changes will be applied after saving.

💡 Tip: Use your browser's search (Ctrl+F / Cmd+F) to quickly find devices by name, room, or type.

error.cannot_connect:
Unable to connect to Homey.

**Possible causes:**
- Wrong IP address or hostname
- Homey is powered off or unreachable on your network
- Firewall blocking connections
- Homey Pro 2019 or older (no Local API – this integration requires Pro 2023 or later)

**Solutions:**
1. Verify the IP in Homey app or router
2. Ensure Homey and Home Assistant are on the same network
3. Try pinging the IP from your Home Assistant host
4. If using Pro 2019 or older, upgrade to Pro 2023+ for API support
error.invalid_auth:
Authentication failed.

**Possible causes:**
- Invalid or expired API key
- API key missing required permissions
- Homey Pro 2019 or older (no API Keys feature – requires Pro 2023 or later)

**Solutions:**
1. In Homey app: Settings → API Keys → Create new key
2. Grant at least: Devices (read), Flows (read), System (read)
3. Copy the key and paste it here
4. If you have Pro 2019 or older, this integration is not supported
error.cannot_fetch_devices: Unable to fetch devices from Homey. The connection was successful but device list could not be retrieved. Proceeding with all devices.

init.title: Homey Options
init.description: Choose what you want to update.

settings.title: Connection & Polling
settings.description:
Update Homey connection settings and fallback polling. Leave API key blank to keep the current one. Polling is only used when Socket.IO is not working. For Socket.IO real-time updates, create a new API key with **System → View System** (`homey.system.readonly`).

Editable text inputs: When enabled, settable string capabilities without predefined options will appear as editable text fields. This disables the read-only sensors below to avoid duplicates.

Read-only strings (default on): When enabled, string capabilities are shown as read-only sensors (useful for status/notification fields). This is ignored if editable text inputs are enabled.

data.token: API Key (leave blank to keep current)
data.expose_settable_text: Expose string capabilities as editable text inputs (disables read-only)
data.expose_readonly_strings: Expose string capabilities as read-only sensors (default, off when editable is enabled)
data.use_capability_titles: Use Homey capability titles for entity names
